A1.name: Rounded rising ping
A1.desc: A smooth, rounded sonar ping that rises gently onto A5, with one soft echo.

A2.name: Delicate high ping
A2.desc: Higher and more delicate (E6), almost a pure tone, a quick soft decay and a faint echo.

A3.name: Warm full ping
A3.desc: Fuller and warmer (D5 with a soft octave below and gentle harmonics), depth without heavy bass or long ringing.

B1.name: Crisp precision ping
B1.desc: Short and crisp (A6) with a quick defining transient, no echo; over in about a third of a second.

B2.name: Refined rising glide
B2.desc: A bright, elegant glide up a fifth (A5 to E6) with a soft octave shimmer at the finish.

B3.name: Crystalline ping
B3.desc: Minimal and precise: a glass-like D6 with faint inharmonic partials, warmed by a soft D5 underneath.

C1.name: Rising sweep
C1.desc: A rising sonar sweep (an octave, A4 to A5) that climbs with the logo and lands on the settle, then rings briefly.

C2.name: Ping with musical resolution
C2.desc: A rounded ping on A5 that resolves into a soft D major colour (D5 and F#5), the home chord of the music.

C3.name: Wavelength signature: ping and returning echo
C3.desc: A sonar ping on A5 whose echo returns higher and warmer, gliding up to lock onto D6: "tune in, gain clarity".
